description: Axe waivers for the pages site CI scans: /, every built /book/ page, and /404. A violation that is not listed fails. A listed violation that no longer reproduces also fails, so delete it once the page is clean. A page with no entry has no waivers. Optional "scheme" is "light" or "dark"; omit it to require the waiver in both.

/book/chapter-8/.summary: A chapter 8 table is display:block with overflow-x:auto in src/styles/book.css (.book-prose table) and has no keyboard access. The selector is the current table position.
